title: Place the mounted weapon
summary: Place the supported mounted minigun and edit its native fields.
outcome: A mounted minigun entity in the map.

sections.title: Place and orient

steps.title: Open Weapons
steps.text: Choose Create → Weapons and select the mounted minigun. Use Place mounted minigun and click a viewport surface.

steps.title: Set behavior fields
steps.text: Select the placed entity, adjust Angles in Gameplay fields, and use Entity properties for native leftarc/rightarc or script fields needed by your map.

tips: The Weapons browser currently exposes the mounted minigun placement workflow. A missing preview does not establish that other weapon placement is available.
